title: review-report-bundle
description: Output of generate_report.py --format json: report + scope + context. Axis results stay separate; no cross-axis score exists. validate_findings.py output is the 'report' member and is the gate source of truth.

invalid.description: findings rejected by the schema — gaps, listed never silent

skipped_axes.description: documented gaps (e.g. spec=SPEC_NOT_AVAILABLE); a skipped axis is never a pass

pass.description: true only if no open blocking finding AND no invalid findings; skipped checks are reported separately

scope.description: git_review.py output (mode, base/target SHAs, diff command, files)

context.description: collect_context.py output (branch, standards, spec status, tools, checks)
